item.summary: fix(cli): parse cron scratch --expected-revision as strict decimal (#119518) The compare-and-swap revision option was parsed with raw Number(), so hexadecimal (0x2) and scientific (1e2) values were silently accepted and used as the CAS revision even though the validation message requires a non-negative integer. Delegate to the shared parseStrictNonNegativeInteger helper used across the CLI so non-decimal input fails fast and no write is attempted.
